core_coverage.answer_quote: Eligible damaging attacks and abilities apply a physical-damage bleed that stacks up to five times.
core_coverage.reason: Explains eligible application, physical damage over time and the five-stack limit.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Reaching five stacks on an enemy champion or killing a champion with R temporarily grants Noxian Might. This grants attack damage and makes eligible bleed applications apply maximum stacks.
core_coverage.reason: Explains both general triggers, temporary empowerment and both benefits. Special R finish exceptions can remain in metadata.

core_coverage.answer_quote: After a windup, Darius swings his axe around himself, dealing physical damage.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the windup, circular swing and damage type.

core_coverage.answer_quote: The outer blade deals more damage and can apply Hemorrhage; the inner handle deals less damage and neither applies nor refreshes it.
core_coverage.reason: Explains both hit regions and their damage and bleed differences.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Blade hits on enemy champions and large monsters heal him based on his missing health and the number of eligible targets hit.
core_coverage.reason: Explains eligible targets, outer-blade requirement and both healing factors without claiming unlimited scaling.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Darius empowers his next basic attack to deal increased physical damage and slow its target.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the empowered attack, increased damage and slow.

core_coverage.answer_quote: W also resets his basic attack timer.
core_coverage.reason: Explicitly states the supported attack reset.

issues: Explain 'resets his basic attack timer' in beginner terms: activating W lets him make his next attack sooner after a basic attack.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Darius passively gains percentage armor penetration for his physical damage.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the passive percentage penetration and its physical-damage scope.

core_coverage.answer_quote: When activated, he sweeps a cone in front of him, pulling enemies hit toward him and slowing them.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the cone, pull and slow. Omitting the supported rebound does not remove this core.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Darius targets an enemy champion with a leap strike that deals true damage, increased by each Hemorrhage stack already on the target.
core_coverage.reason: Explains champion targeting and true damage without claiming a guaranteed execution or unrestricted movement.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Darius targets an enemy champion with a leap strike that deals true damage, increased by each Hemorrhage stack already on the target.
core_coverage.reason: Explicitly ties increased damage to stacks already present.

core_coverage.answer_quote: A qualifying kill lets him use R again through a temporary recast window; at maximum rank, it resets the cooldown permanently.
core_coverage.reason: Explains qualified kill-based reuse and distinguishes the maximum-rank reset.
